items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: I'd go over there and play with the Vidal. You heard it of the Vidal band. I'd play with the Vidal sometimes three and four nights.

ctx.x: Well what kind of music did you use here with your Parks band? Marches, things of this kind?

Well I tell you, after we stopped playing, you understand, like that, we used to use all kinds of music. We didn't use hardly any marches because it was always a dance music we used to play, you see. And like I tell you, we didn't have no music at all. We just had to pick it up the best way we could. And believe me, we used to pick it up. Yes, we used to pick it up. How would you pick it up? Anywhere we'd hear a song. You know what I used to do? I used to leave here like on a Monday or Tuesday, and I'd go over…
You'd bring the whole thing back?
